title: A lamp on a pushbutton
description: Wire a 24 V supply, a START pushbutton and a lamp so the lamp lights only while the button is held.
objectives: Connect the supply to the button and the button to the lamp
Return the lamp to the supply common
The lamp is off at rest, on while pressed, off again when released
hints: A lamp is a load: current needs a path from P24 through it to M0
Use the multimeter across the lamp terminals to see where voltage is missing
